name: ONED USD
oneLiner: ONED is a Gennius-branded dollar token backed by USDC held by Coinbase, with 1:1 conversion for eligible Coinbase accounts.
collateral: USDC held in Coinbase custody, with itemized Base reserve wallets published by Coinbase; token-specific legal segregation and insolvency priority are unverified.
pegMechanism: Eligible Coinbase accounts can deposit native ONED from external wallets and convert ONED 1:1 with USDC. New York, Canada and the European Economic Area are excluded on Coinbase. Copies, wrapped and bridged ONED are not redeemable under native holder terms.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Base token is a distinct Coinbase Custom Stablecoin for Gennius, backed 1:1 by Coinbase-custodied USDC and convertible by eligible accounts. This is a core custody-layer instrument with USDC collateral rather than a direct on-chain wrapper.

proofOfReserves.provider: Coinbase itemized ONED reserve and supply dashboard; no token-specific independent financial attestor identified
